architecture.mechanism: a circular dual-lumen catheter wall carrying two parallel circular lumens separated by a solid septum; wall stiffness resists kinking and septum thickness resists suction collapse
architecture.intervention: outer diameter 7 mm, two lumens 2.5 mm, septum 0.9 mm, length 400 mm
architecture.expected_effect: lumens stay patent through a 15 mm bend radius at 40 kPa suction

parameters.role: Diameter of the inner lumen of the catheter
